title: CT angiogram s0727, groin to carotid (planning only)

source.dataset: TotalSegmentator dataset v2.0.1 (small subset), subject s0727, University Hospital Basel; Wasserthal et al., Radiology: AI 2023; https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.10047263. Arterial masks converted with 3D Slicer 5.13.0 and SlicerVMTK by ThreadSim slicer/export_case.py.

scenario: Teaching scenario: a real CT angiogram's arteries, from both groins to both common carotids. Plan a route on real anatomy. Planning only: there is no physics wire for this case.
